summary: Frontend-only regression for AMYA homepage layout refinement at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x900). All 8 requested checks pass: compact header (65px) with logo/cart/menu; hero copy, eyebrow, description, Shop/Our Story CTAs navigate correctly; trust line present and old amya-difference section REMOVED; products section placed immediately after trust line; mobile grid is exactly 2 cols (169+169px) with uniform card widths; all 4 category chips navigate to populated category pages (cashew-brittles=1, spices=6, pickles=6, oils=4 products); add-to-cart for Cashew Brittle increments header badge to 1 and cart drawer shows correct item with WhatsApp send button; lower sections render as concise brand story + 3-step ordering + terracotta contact (WA + call) with no duplicate/overlap. Desktop: 4-col grid (280px x4) and hero image visible at 477x596. No WhatsApp FAB overlap with add-to-cart buttons on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: CartDrawer auto-opens after addItem, which can block subsequent navigation in UI flows and auto-tests. Consider only showing a toast or adding a short auto-close; leaving the drawer open after a tap is acceptable UX but documented here for awareness.
Two 401s from external asset(s) on load persist from prior iteration (not /api). Non-blocking.
DialogContent (CartDrawer) a11y warning noted in prior iteration still applies if not patched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage order confirmed: Hero -> trust-line -> shop-products-section (2 cols mobile, 4 cols desktop) -> brand-story-section -> ordering steps -> terracotta contact. Category chip testids: category-link-cashew-brittles | -spices | -pickles | -oils. Hero CTAs: hero-shop-btn (/shop), hero-story-btn (/our-story). Cart WhatsApp number 919675334567 verified. amya-difference testid no longer in DOM.
